source: ClinicalTrials.gov record histories read in a browser (read-only, public pages) on 2026-10-11; the history endpoint rejects scripts, so this was not run from the repository.
population: 200 registered Phase 2 melanoma trials started 2015 or later, DRUG or BIOLOGICAL (the demo protocol's peer set). 111 had at least one registry edit to the Eligibility module after the first posting.
method: For each trial, the first edit that RELAXED a metric (inclusion or exclusion criteria count down by 2 or more; minimum age lowered; maximum age raised or removed). The pre-edit value was compared with the other 199 trials' latest values using the hotspot rule (>= 85th percentile and above the peer upper quartile). Counts come from the registry's free-text criteria and are approximate. Control: every other trial's latest value on the same metric, same rule.
caveats: Exploratory: four metrics were tested and no multiple-comparison correction was applied; only the inclusion-count result is individually significant.
The peer distribution is each peer's LATEST record, which includes the edits we are testing against.
A trial can appear under more than one metric, so metrics are not independent and are not pooled.
Registry criteria text is free text; counts are bullets or non-empty lines and are approximate.
This tests only the peer-outlier (hotspot) signal on registry fields, not the whole Pre-Flight pipeline, which reads the protocol PDF; earlier PDFs are not available.
